optimized_sql:
SELECT MIN(cn.name) AS movie_company, MIN(mi_idx.info) AS rating, MIN(t.title) AS western_violent_movie
FROM title AS t
JOIN movie_companies AS mc
  ON mc.movie_id = t.id
 AND mc.note NOT LIKE '%(USA)%'
 AND mc.note LIKE '%(200%)%'
JOIN movie_info AS mi
  ON mi.movie_id = t.id
JOIN movie_info_idx AS mi_idx
  ON mi_idx.movie_id = t.id
JOIN movie_keyword AS mk
  ON mk.movie_id = t.id
JOIN keyword AS k
  ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
JOIN kind_type AS kt
  ON kt.id = t.kind_id
JOIN info_type AS it1
  ON it1.id = mi.info_type_id AND it1.info = 'countries'
JOIN info_type AS it2
  ON it2.id = mi_idx.info_type_id AND it2.info = 'rating'
JOIN company_type AS ct
  ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
JOIN company_name AS cn
  ON cn.id = mc.company_id
WHERE cn.country_code != '[us]'
  AND k.keyword IN ('murder', 'murder-in-title', 'blood', 'violence')
  AND kt.kind IN ('movie', 'episode')
  AND mi.info IN ('Germany', 'German', 'USA', 'American')
  AND mi_idx.info < '7.0'
  AND t.production_year > 2008
